rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/construction/transmittals/v1/projects/{projectId}/transmittals/{transmittalId}/folders
user context optional
data:read
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via either a two-legged or three-legged OAuth flow.

The Autodesk ID of the user on whose behalf the request is made.
This header is required only when using two-legged authentication. It is not needed for three-legged authentication.
Your application can access only those users who are assigned to it in the SaaS Integrations UI.
Only user Autodesk IDs (autodeskId) are supported.

The ID of the project.
You can retrieve the project ID using the Data Management API. For more details, see the Retrieve a Project ID tutorial.
You may provide the project ID with or without the b. prefix:

With prefix: b.657a5565-09b7-48e0-bd03-acacfe42efaf
Without prefix: 657a5565-09b7-48e0-bd03-acacfe42efaf
The ID of the transmittal. To find the ID, call GET transmittals.

The maximum number of results to return per page.
Acceptable values: 1-200.
Default value: 20.
For example, to limit the response to two results per page, use limit=2.

The index from which the response starts returning results.
Default value: 0.
For example, to skip the first three results, use offset=3.

Sorts the folders by a supported field and order.
By default, folders are sorted in ascending order by name (name asc).
To sort in descending order, add desc after the field name.
Format: sort=<field> [asc or desc]
Supported fields: name, lastUpdatedAt, updatedByName.
Examples:

sort=name asc – sorts folders alphabetically by name.
sort=lastUpdatedAt desc – sorts folders by last updated time in descending order.

Possible values: name, lastUpdatedAt, updatedByName, name asc, lastUpdatedAt asc, updatedByName asc, name desc, lastUpdatedAt desc, updatedByName desc
Successfully retrieved the folders of the transmittal
The transmittal has been created and is currently being processed but not ready for review yet. The folders list will be empty.

The user does not have permission to perform this operation.
The project or transmittal does not exist.
Internal server error
The list of folders included in the transmittal.
The URN of the folder.
The name of the folder.
The description of the folder.
The date and time when the folder was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.
The Autodesk ID of the user who last modified the folder.
The Autodesk ID of the user who last modified the folder. For details about the user, call GET user.

Indicates whether the folder is deleted.
true – The folder is deleted, either directly or because its parent folder was deleted.
false – The folder is not deleted.
The list of pagination details for the response.
The maximum number of results returned per page.
The number of results skipped before the current page, starting from zero.
The total number of results that match the query, regardless of pagination.
The URL to retrieve the next page of transmittal folders. If not included, this is the last page.
This list of folders will be empty.
